question: In Breast trials, normalize the type of follow-up into imaging, clinical, or mixed.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    "NCT",
    CASE
        WHEN "Type of follow-up given" LIKE '%Imaging%' AND "Type of follow-up given" LIKE '%Clinical%' THEN 'Mixed'
        WHEN "Type of follow-up given" LIKE '%Imaging%' THEN 'Imaging'
        WHEN "Type of follow-up given" LIKE '%Clinical%' THEN 'Clinical'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS normalized_follow_up
FROM compat.clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Breast'
